overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Hawaii men's volleyball team, known as the Rainbow Warriors, for winning the 2026 NCAA (National Collegiate Athletic Association) men's volleyball national championship. The team beat the University of California, Irvine, 3 sets to 1 for the program's third national title and set a school record for wins in a season. The resolution recognizes the players' hard work and the excitement they brought to Hawaii. It is ceremonial and does not change any law or spending. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 14, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a fitting way to honor a record-setting team and its national championship.
against: Critics say it is purely ceremonial and doesn't change any law or spending.
